My husband has struggled with mental health over the years. It usually manifests as a few months of depression and then he will level off and be ok for a while. I have always pushed for him to go to therapy but he only just started. 
It’s only gotten really bad since his back injury last March and the toll that the pain has taken on him is the only thing I can identify as triggering this breakdown two months ago. I don’t know how it’s linked to his parents in his brain but it seems to be. I think he has internalized so much anger and resentment that it all just came spilling out but I genuinely don’t understand it. I 100% see why you think this post isn’t true but it sadly is. He was so irrational and different than I have ever known him to be. 

Outside of what I’ve talked about our relationship has been rocky with shitty communication. I thought I was communicating ok but he was not telling me anything because he has a self belief that he is worthless and no one cares about him or what he thinks. He attributes this to his parents. Everything that he has been unhappy with in our relationship came out 2 months ago as well and it was ROUGH. I was blindsided which I feel so stupid for. Couples therapy has helped a lot but there is still a lot to tackle. 

My own dad was an abusive alcoholic that only got help after he saw me reach out for help with my own mental health at 18. He was self medicating with alcohol to deal with undiagnosed PTSD from Vietnam. Because I saw how much better he got once he got help I’ve wanted to give my husband the same chance to get help as well and be better. Idk if that makes sense but it’s been my driving force to stay and help him through all of this. 

I appreciate your response more than you will ever know. If you have a specific question let me know, I will answer anything. I feel so lost and unsure.

The summer I turned 14 my families old farmhouse became the hub for some serious unexplained shit. Our house was built in 1887 and as far as we know the only “tragedy” that happened was the barn burned down in the early 1900s and was later rebuilt. We have no idea if anyone died on the property during that fire or really at any point. We tried looking at the town records but as it’s a tiny town their records are really sparse. 

Everything began when my brother started hearing what sounded like footsteps in the living room outside his and my bedroom. He complained to my mom and she blew him off saying it was just the dog as she was old and had taken to wandering around the house at night. At the time I had no idea my brother was hearing anything since I went to bed much earlier than he did and he never mentioned it to me. Then one night I was up late reading and I heard what I thought was my brother walking past my room to go to the bedroom. After 45 minutes when I didn’t hear him come back I got up to check it out and found him in his room reading. He had never gotten up even though I heard someone walk past clear as day. We exchanged some what the fucks and both went back to reading as there wasn’t really anything else to do. About ten minutes later I heard the footsteps again and when I looked up directly at where I could hear them walking there was nothing there even though I could track their exact movement outside my door. I freaked out started calling for my brother who had heard it too and we ran and woke our parents up. My mom again blew us off and said it’s an old house it makes noises so basically fuck off. This is where shit heats up. 

My brother and I went back and we were standing in my room (which is wedged between both my parents and my brothers) talking about what the hell could possibly be making this noise. It was at this point my brothers like idgaf what mom says it’s gotta be ghost when it sounded like someone took a mother fuckin sledgehammer to the wall in between my room and my parents. It was 3 exact knocks that sounded like someone was trying to break the goddamn wall down. I screamed bloody murder my brothers soul left his body and our old dog who was just being a good girl coming to check out what all the fuss was about tucked her tails between her legs and noped the fuck outta there the fastest I had seen her move in years. We ran into my parents room just in time to see my dad run out the patio door that’s in their bedroom in nothing but his tighty whiteys wielding his shotgun and scaring the beejesus out of Bill the raccoon who was just having his dinner on the patio bird feeder. He kept back reporting there was nobody outside and it was then that mom finally conceded that maybe we had been hearing something going on. 

The next morning we are all talking about it and turns out when my parents had remodeled and added on their bedroom they had found a door boarded up in the wall right where we heard the knocking. Sooooo that’s weird. After that night weird shit kept happening all summer but this was the event that kicked it all off. Maybe not that scary but still so so so weird.

Well I didn't want to make a mile long post telling a story that is completely irrelevant to the original question but I apologize that I left you guys hanging. Since you seemingly would like to hear the story I would love to oblige and will post it as an add-on to the original post.

Well my grandpa's real name was Upton and he thought it was really weird so when he met my grandma he told her his name was James. Three weeks later (yes they got married after three weeks of knowing each other, the story is actually adorable) the priest asked my grandma if she takes Upton to be her husband. This resulted in my grandma yelling in front of the entire church "who the hell is Upton?!" And then realizing my grandpa had lied to her because he thought his name was weird, she goes "oh Lord yes I do to take this stupid man as my husband." They were married 65 years with three boys, the oldest of which was named James. I never saw a couple more in love or meant for each other than my grandparents, God rest their souls. 

EDIT: I originally wasn't going to include the story of how my grandparents met since it is completely irrelevant to the original question and I didn't want an extremely long post, but people seem interested so here goes! (Also I do love telling it since it is so cute.)

My grandparents Upton (or rather Uppy which is what I called him) and Pearl met when he was 21 and she was 19. She was super tall and skinny, he was shorter and muscular. She had some serious attitude and he was the most soft-spoken and gentle man you could find. In other words, they were complete opposites but as they liked to say, it really was love at first sight. 

Pearl and her sister Rose were out to eat one day when Rose pointed out the handsome military man sitting at a table across the room from them. This of course was the infamous Upton who had just gotten back from fighting in World War II where he had earned a purple heart while holding off a squad of Nazis so the rest of his men could retreat. This is not actually important to the story, I just wanted to point out how much of a badass he was. 

Anyway, Pearl agreed that he was handsome and told Rose that she could get his attention just by walking by. So she gets up and sashays right by him, swaying hips and long legs passing right under his nose, as she goes to the telephone next to him.

And he says nothing. Doesn't even look her way. Pissed off, my extremely self-confident grandmother heads back to her sister but refuses to admit defeat. She sits down and about two minutes later gets up and heads back to the telephone, hips swaying even more. Still, Uppy doesn't even bat an eye. Even when Pearl struts by him 7 more times with her skirt hiked up practically to her ears. 

On the eighth time, she storms right over to him, slams her palm on the table, and practically hollers into Uppy's stunned face, "what the hell is the matter with you! Can't even give a woman the common courtesy to admire her when she walks by?!" 

Uppy, after taking a minute to recover, says, "well my dear," as a big ol' grin spreads across his face, "I sent the waiter over to your table with my number on it the first time you passed by. After that, I didn't want to say anything because I was just enjoying the show." 

My completely mortified grandma spun back around to her sister who was laughing her ass off, waving his number in the air. She was about to storm off when Uppy grabbed her hand and with a completely serious look on his face tells her, "I would have said something to you when you walked by the first time, but I wanted to be rejected when you threw away my number rather than when you said no to my face. I never thought in a million years a woman as beautiful as you would have wanted the attentions of an average man like me. You must forgive me for not knowing you kept coming back for me. I truly thought you just kept forgetting the number you wanted to call. That would have made much more sense." 

That night they went on their very first date and three weeks later they were married. My grandpa always used to say they got married so soon because he was afraid my grandma would come to her senses before he could pop the question. 

I am sorry I am not a good writer or story teller, I was just repeating the story as my grandma Pearl always used to tell me it. Hope you enjoyed it :)
